div.head: Rect 5.1
div.ab: [5.1] Mid us is geræd, þæt he sylle V sustras huniges to gafole; on suman landum gebyreð mare gafolræden.
In quibusdam locis est institutum reddi VI sestaria mellis ad censum; in quibusdam locis plus gabli redditur.
On suman landum gebyreð mare gafol|ræden.
Mid us is geræd þæt he sylle V sustras huniges to gafole; on suman landum gebyreð mare gafolræden.
Bei uns ist festgesetzt, dass er 5 (6 Quadr.) Sextar Honig als Abgabe gebe; auf einigen Landgütern gebührt sich weitere Abgabenpflicht.
With us it is laid down that he give 5 (6, Quadr.) sesters of honey as rent; on some estates a greater rent is due.
In some estates it is custom that a greater tax [is] due.
Among us it is agreed that he is to pay five sesters of honey as dues; on some estates, it is the practice to assess a greater amount.
div.note: Liebermann would correct ‘V’ to ‘VI’ (compare 4.1). B's ‘sustras’ stands so. The Quadripartitus avoids the first person (here, 5.4 and 21.4), probably so as not to be identified with the author.
